name: Gerald R. Ford-class aircraft carrier, drawn as USS Gerald R. Ford (CVN-78)

published.source: en.wikipedia 'Gerald R. Ford-class aircraft carrier': 337 m overall, 78 m flight deck, 41 m waterline, 12 m draught

reference_notes: US Navy 'Overhead view of USS Gerald R. Ford (CVN 78) transiting the Atlantic Ocean, March 19, 2023' (Commons): deck outline, island, lifts, catapults, pendants - the builder's header gives the grid. Not copied into specs/ref: Commons answered 429 to every request in batch 5.
'Broadside view of USS Gerald R. Ford (CVN-78) underway on 8 April 2017' (port side): deck height, island and mast heights, bow flare, stern overhang.
'221009-N-TL968-1248' (9 Oct 2022, bow quarter) and the 8 April 2017 bow view: island faces, the square DBR arrays, the mast.
must_show: small island set well aft on the starboard edge: main block x -93..-75, y -35.45..-22.75, with an annex aft to x -99; roof at z 42.8
dual band radar: three hexagon faces 120 degrees apart (one forward, one on each after quarter), a 4.3 m SPY-4 array low at z 30.2 and a 2.8 m SPY-3 array high at z 39.2 on each
one tapered mast off the roof at x -84.6 with yards at z 49.0 and 56.2, the big radome at its head (z 58.9) and the pole to z 63.8; two SATCOM radomes on the roof at x -80.2 and -87.4
three deck-edge lifts: starboard x 2..28 and x -75..-49 (y -35..-19.4, both forward of the island), port quarter x -163.5..-141.5 (y 20.6..35.4)

four EMALS tracks: two up the bow from x 38 to 161, two in the waist from x -50.5 and -68.5 to x 77 and 63.4, with the raised bow blast deflectors at x 37.3 and flush waist deflectors at x -53 and -71
three AAG pendants across the 8.5 degree landing area at landing-axis stations -107.5, -94.5, -81.5, the Fresnel lens on the port edge at x -90
angled deck corner at (59.5, 41.6); starboard bow cut from (75, -34.8) to (91.5, -18.6) with the RAM sponson low outboard of it at x 101.5

catwalks with safety nets, stanchioned hand rail and life-raft racks round every straight deck edge at z 17.3..18.6; folding whips on the catwalks at x -46, -12, 40, 56 (starboard) and -128, -104, -80 (port); the tall pole at x 60
hull flaring hard from the hangar deck (z 9.2) out to the deck edge, raked stem over a bulb, square transom at x -160 under an 8.5 m overhang; plain paint, no hull number
not_confirmed: stations of the Mk 29, RAM and Phalanx mounts and the four M2 tubs are inferred from broadsides that cannot resolve them
the cat lead-in lines and the scorch behind the bow deflectors (batch 5): drawn as US carriers paint them, their exact run not measured
the island balcony lockers, roof whips and catwalk hose-reel lockers (batch 5): photographs show clutter there, positions approximate
no outline reference: Commons rate-limited every fetch in batch 5
